record.nameCollision: Passive.STAMINA (this record) is NOT EffectEnum.STAMINA, the NORMAL-synergy tier effect that gives +15 shield at simulation start (normalShieldEffect). The two share a name only (queue uncertainty NAME_SHARED_WITH_EFFECT).
record.kind: periodic self shield on damage received (OnDamageReceivedEffect in PassiveEffects)
record.summary: Passive.STAMINA is registered in PassiveEffects (passives.ts:1594) as one OnDamageReceivedEffect. MUDBRAY (1 star) and MUDSDALE (2 stars) are GROUND + FIELD, maxPP 45, range 1, skill HIGH_HORSEPOWER. Each time the holder survives a damage event that dealt takenDamage > 0 (PokemonState.handleDamage calls onDamageReceived only if takenDamage > 0 and hp > 0 afterwards), damageReceivedCount is incremented and, when the new count is a multiple of 10 (10th, 20th, ...), the holder gains a shield: requested 20, addShield(20, self, apBoost 1, crit false). Applied amount: Big Eater Belt first makes 20 into 25 (x1.25 rounded down, a positive self-buff), then the shield is multiplied by (1 + AP/100) of the holder (the holder is its own caster), halved if the holder is enraged, rounded and added to pokemon.shield; the shield is added only while hp > 0 (always the case in this path). Twist Band is not called in addShield. takenDamage counts damage absorbed by an existing shield, so shield-absorbed hits also count toward the 10 (taken from the shared helper section J1; the passive uses the count, not the hp loss); a lethal hit does not run the effect. Nothing in the effect reads stars: MUDBRAY and MUDSDALE get the same 20. No gameplay claims; source reading plus mechanical checks only.
triggers: PokemonEntity.onDamageReceived on the holder after handleDamage with takenDamage > 0 and hp > 0 (including retaliation damage, attackType not filtered)

effects.declaredRaw: 20 shield on every 10th damage event received
effects.scaling: AP: addShield apBoost 1 with the holder as caster -> x(1 + ap/100); no crit; no star scaling
effects.resolution: requested 20. Applied: Big Eater Belt -> floor(20 x 1.25) = 25 when held (applied before AP scaling), then x(1 + ap/100), then x0.5 if enraged, then Math.round; shield = max(0, shield + value). Shield is only added if hp > 0. This is a shield (pokemon.shield), not a heal: handleHeal / Protect / Rune Protect are not involved. The shield later absorbs damage in handleDamage and counts as takenDamage there.

damageReceivedCount starts at 0 and is incremented at the start of every onDamageReceived call, so the shield is given at counts 10, 20, 30...; the count is not reset by the shield and counts every qualifying damage event of any type (physical, special, true, retaliation) with takenDamage > 0 and surviving hp.

conditions: Damage events with takenDamage 0 (fully prevented) do not call onDamageReceived and so do not count; lethal hits do not call it either.
The count is shared with every other user of count.damageReceivedCount on the same entity (no other reader was found in app/core and app/models).
The NORMAL-synergy STAMINA effect (EffectEnum.STAMINA) is separate; a holder with both gets both, which is not described here.
EffectEnum.STAMINA name collision is documented in the name-collision evidence.
record.resetBehaviour: Per fight: damageReceivedCount starts at 0 and is not reset during the fight; the shield stays until absorbed.

MUDSDALE: 2 stars, GROUND + FIELD, maxPP 45, range 1, skill HIGH_HORSEPOWER
OnDamageReceivedEffect: when damageReceivedCount % 10 === 0 the holder gains a shield of 20 requested, caster = itself, apBoost 1, crit false
every call increments damageReceivedCount first, then runs berries, sleep/charm reductions and every OnDamageReceivedEffect of the holder
onDamageReceived is called only when takenDamage > 0 and the holder still has hp > 0 after the hit (a lethal hit does not call it)

addShield first passes the value through applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff (x1.25 rounded down for a positive value when the holder has Big Eater Belt), then PokemonState.addShield; there is no Twist Band call in this path
only if hp > 0: shield x (1 + ap x apBoost / 100); crit multiplier if crit; x0.5 if the target is enraged and the shield is positive; Math.round; pokemon.shield = max(0, shield + value)
Big Eater Belt: positive change x1.25 rounded down (0 digits)
damageReceivedCount starts at 0 for the fight
EffectEnum.STAMINA is the NORMAL-synergy tier effect (+15 shield at simulation start) and only shares the name with Passive.STAMINA
